payout_quote: If a beverage meets the criteria below, it will need to be labeled with the HI 5¢ deposit / Redemption centers are responsible for accepting empty deposit beverage containers, for which a deposit has been paid, and paying the refund value of five cents per container to the people redeeming the containers.
steps: Buy eligible beverages in Hawaii (5¢ refundable deposit + 1¢ nonrefundable container fee at checkout)
Bring them to a certified HI-5 redemption center
catches: This returns YOUR OWN deposit money paid at purchase — it is recovering your own money, not new income.
Only containers bought in-state with the correct deposit label are redeemable; out-of-state containers are ineligible and redeeming them is fraud.
The 1¢ container fee is NOT refundable — you always lose 1¢ per container. Redeeming containers without the HI 5¢ label is rejected.
biggest_catch: Returns your own 5¢ deposit — you paid it at purchase (plus a nonrefundable 1¢ fee). This is deposit recovery, not income.
eligibility: Anyone returning HI 5¢-labeled containers in Hawaii.
timing: Refund paid at certified redemption center.
